content_md:
The biggest limitation of business thinking is that there's no framework in their repertoire that in some way suggests people to start an organization to walk on the moon, send a rover to the mars. While business is largely art, it's imagination is structurally bounded; and to cause generational shifts requires different kind of imagination. Business thinking limits itself to the realm of known possibility, and human civilization elevates when someone shows for the first time what's possible, and no business plan really captures that in spirit. 

The second biggest limitation: most business theories are not forward consistent. They mostly only make sense in the retrospect. Theorizers play catch up making their revising their current theories to be consistent with the changing world.
